page.layout: One printed page, rotated: a tree diagram with braces in the upper part of the scan, with a label beside a brace at the right. No running text, no margins with text.; One diagram across the page: a braced outline running from the top to the bottom, with the leftmost box "Minus" and the rightmost box "cesit Peripatetici" at the far right. No running text, page number or catchword.; Diagram on the page: a tree of braces, read from top to bottom. Philosophi at the top-left, branching to Occidentales and Græcorum. Under Græcorum, Toëtæ, Poëtæ and Italica Pythagoras branch further, with Ionica and Milesii beneath. Cynicam, Epicuream and Stoicam sit at the right, with Academicam at the foot.; One rotated tree diagram in the page body, read by turning the scan 90 degrees clockwise. Its boxes are set in braces and lines, with no running text or notes.

main_text.l: Dd. Scholastici, quorum tres sunt status.

page.notes: The diagram is printed sideways (rotated), and the scan is cut off below. The label "Dd. Scholastici, quorum tres sunt status." runs over two lines and its second line is partly cut at the right edge. "Latista" is read from a slightly blurred word and could be "Latina" [?]. The brace structure is read from the drawing; the level of "Dd. Scholastici" is my reading of the brace position. The brace structure is only partly visible. The nesting levels are read from the relative positions of the boxes and braces, and the levels of "Latinorum", "Philosophi" and "cesit Peripatetici" are uncertain. The word before "Peripatetici" is cut off at the top edge and is doubtful. The long s is written as s throughout, so "cesit" is uncertain. The diagram is rotated on the scan and the nesting of the braces is hard to follow; the levels are my best reading. Toëtæ and the line "Academicam, quæ fuit" are uncertain. Several words of the Ionica and Italica branches are split across lines, and their hyphens are as printed. The diagram is printed sideways, so the levels are read from the braces as they stand on the rotated page. Brachmanes and Gymnosophista are each opened by a brace from the Magi Persarum and Indorum boxes, so they sit one level deeper. The position of Druides Gallorum relative to Prisci is uncertain: its bracket lies at the far left, and I have placed it at level 2 as a companion of Prisci. The small dark spot near Sacri is a stain, not printed text.
